riders.note: The arrow finds whoever the Saint has named, through any barrier short of a planar boundary.

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

Any creature you can name within a mile, through any barrier short of a planar boundary. It takes @Golden Arrow's damage, plus an additional 8 dice.

Automation note: Foundry has no way to target a creature purely by name, off the current scene or otherwise undetected — this reaches anyone on the viewed scene within range, ignoring line of effect, which is the mechanical half of the Boon. Naming a creature elsewhere on the map is the GM's call.

Granted by the Sagittarius Zenith Boon.
